saw_lines: Custom branded socks get bought by someone buying for a team, event or client, who checks minimums and turnaround first.
So the minimum and turnaround belong in the first line of your ad, or the buyer clicks to a rival.
Your site offers 5 pairs for £25 and free shipping over £40. Open new text ads with that offer and test it against your 21 image ads.
